Supported copies split into structurally different groups of 47 and 47 (within-group identity 0.84, between 0.73, excess over a random split 0.107). But group membership shuffles between the 5' end, the middle and the 3' end (consistency 0.08, against 0.56 for a real subfamily split): the copies are not two families so much as patchwork, which is worth looking at by eye.

34 % of the element is simple tandem repeat in the median copy (86 % in the top tenth). Every family Sergei accepted in hydra sits at or below 7 %, and no class in the labelled corpus reaches 1 %.
